cohort_2016.source_row_identity: 232/232 exact 2016 AllData vs seedCnt by plantID, site/week/treat/seedCnt/noFlrs/seedPerFlr; 62/62 pollenDep vs AllData site/week/treat and pollen counts
cohort_2016.sources_P_sentinel: 9999999 is missing (PDF); 62 P source rows, controls bagged have no P measured
cohort_2016.seed_ratio_identity: 62/62 joined seedPerFlr equals seedCnt/noFlrs with positive noFlrs
cohort_2016.clone_triplet_membership: Original 2016 metadata describes visited/open/bagged clone-matched ramet triplets, but no independent clone ID has yet been source-certified. Do not treat 62 as 62 independent clone lines.
cohort_2016.P_and_F_same_flower_caution: Original pollen stigma sampled from marked flowers and seed number aggregated across all marked flowers on each ramet; same ramet proven, same individual flower NOT proven.

cohort_2015.source_pollen_subsamples: 186 individual stigma source rows from 36 plants; mean source mcPolCnt/nonMcPolCnt in 2015 Means
cohort_2015.source_seeds: 508 source flower seedCnt rows from all 40 plants; mSeed in Means
cohort_2015.source_visit: mVisRate in Means for all 40; repeated polObs log had blank style-only rows 1..221 and 330 data rows 223..552.
cohort_2015.seasonal_intervention: Week 4 was initially observed 15 hours with no visitors, then cut flowers were added and another 15 hours observed, therefore source Q is intervention-conditional
cohort_2015.P_F_same_flower_caution: Pollen sampled from ~5.2 stigmas per plant; seeds averaged over tagged flowers. Only same PLANT-level match, not same individual flower.

primary_2016.question: Does measured stigmatic CP+HP pollen receipt add reliable heldout-week prediction of mean seeds per marked flower, beyond taxon identity and recorded visits/exposure?
primary_2016.observation_unit: one original plantID ramet, 62 matched joint pollen-seed rows only, not 235 independent marked flowers
primary_2016.response: original seedPerFlr in [0,4], without adjusting response by outcome or omitting zeros
primary_2016.M0: intercept + week numeric + site=SP binary + log1p(FlrsAvail) + log1p(noFlrs) + log1p(observed flrsVisited/noFlrs) (O controls source NA flrsVisited explicitly 0 observed visits) + three visitor indicators Bombus/Muscoidea/Osmia (Open reference)
primary_2016.visitor_coding: Only source AllData visID in {Open,Bombus,Muscoidea,Osmia}, no hoverfly in 62, no bagged controls in matched 62. Do NOT use insect identity from 2015 on 2016 ramet.
primary_2016.classification_note: Single-visit visitor assigned to ramet, observed rate not a true community visitation time series; P counts are transferred grains not genetically compatible pollen.
primary_2016.fit: Gaussian ridge lambda=1 on train-only means/population SD of all non-intercept predictors (including interaction), intercept unpenalized; zero SD sets scaler 1; fixed intercept adjustment; clamp M0/M1 predictions to [0,4]; no hyperparameter search
primary_2016.primary_validation: five leave-one-WHOLE-observation-week-out folds, group sizes [4,18,16,20,4], no random ramet folds
primary_2016.success_gate: pooled ramet-weighted M0-M1 MSE strictly positive and >=5% M0 relative improvement and >=4/5 observation week folds strictly positive
primary_2016.report: Five fold sizes, M0/M1 MSE/MAE, pooled, positive folds, all source inclusion/failure states, no p-values
primary_2016.independence_limit: weeks1-3 exclusively RG and weeks4-5 exclusively SP in the 62-source matched sample; week effect is confounded with site. Five folds do NOT represent five independent ecosystems.

secondary_2016.design: Two leave-one-entire-site-out folds (RG 38, SP24), same exact M0/M1 predictor recipe, use training-only normalization. Site term is constant in training and its prediction is not an identifiable causal site effect.
secondary_2016.role: descriptive site transfer only; 2 sites too few for a robust generalization gate, and Osmia only RG in matched sample.
secondary_2016.no_rescue: Cannot rescue negative primary via site subtotal or favorable taxon.

secondary_2015.question: Does pollen receipt add phenology-week heldout seed-per-flower prediction within a different potted-plant experiment of the SAME original published programme?
secondary_2015.unit: 36 source-matched potted maternal plants, weeks [10,9,10,7], not the 2016 ramets or independent original studies
secondary_2015.response: original source mSeed (seeds per tagged flower, 0..4), not follow-up recruitment
secondary_2015.M0: intercept + tWeek numeric + log1p(mVisRate) + log1p(flrCnt) + mVWC soil water
secondary_2015.fit: same Gaussian ridge lambda=1, train-only standardization and [0,4] clipping
secondary_2015.important_confounds: Different pollen and seed flowers aggregated at plant level; week4 cut-flower display intervention changed effort; all plants from a single manipulated source field programme.
secondary_2015.no_rescue: Secondary cannot rescue 2016 primary decision; do not pool 2015/2016 as two independent studies.

firewalls: PREOUTCOME NOTE: only source ZIP SHA, PDF methods and schema, source identifier matches, distribution of missingness and eligibility were examined before this protocol. No pollen×seed outcome correlation/model was fitted.
Original paper already showed Bombus per-visit effectiveness partly offset falling visit rates across phenology: prior art, not a new finding.
Strict same-ramet Q/P/F subset, not same flower, and no supported causal pollen mediation. Clone triplets are nested with unknown grouping IDs.
Do not add pollen source imputation for 170 2016 non-assayed ramets or claim missing P means zero. 62/232 P sample is outcome-assay selected.
2015 vs 2016 are two experimental frames in same scientific programme and should not be treated as separate independent landscape replication.
All source retention/outcome transformations/models/positive gates fixed before new outcome fits. No variable selection/site exclusion/alternative outcome to chase positive effects.
No extra confirmed complete QPF original independent programmes added beyond the frozen source atlas. One published 2020 system.
Only source-free aggregate counts/fold errors may be uploaded. No original ZIP/XLSX/PDF, original ramet IDs, individual pollen/seed/visit values or clone labels.
